profile.headline: iOS engineer: async UI; app & media perf
profile.summary: An experienced engineer with a passion for mobile and open-source software at scale. My work has been used by 500+ million MAUs (monthly active users) in revenue and performance critical surfaces of apps like Pinterest, YouTube, Telegram, Apollo for Reddit, Google Search/Assistant, and Reddit.

positions.title: Open Source Maintainer - Texture's Core team
positions.description:
Core contributor and maintainer of Texture (formerly AsyncDisplayKit) — a well-known multi-threaded UI framework for iOS.
• Power(s/ed) revenue and performance critical surfaces of apps like Pinterest, YouTube, Telegram, Apollo for Reddit, Google Search/Assistant, and Reddit.
• Most significant contribution: Designed, implemented and maintained Texture's declarative flexbox-based layout system since late 2015 (~4 years before SwiftUI came out).

Author of Weaver — a remote layout debugger for Texture-powered apps.

Contributor of PINRemoteImage, PINCache, and PINOperation.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed Chatwing messaging Android and iOS apps until each had tens of thousands of users and a 99%+ crash-free rate.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped develop PicCollage Android app until it reached 5+ million installs, 4.3 stars Play Store rating, and a 99.9% crash-free rate.

positions.title: Android Software Engineer & Co-founder
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained multiple Android applications, notably AndroidPC and AutoScreen which together had thousands of paid users.
• Also took some contract work.

projects.title: Texture (formerly AsyncDisplayKit)
projects.description:
Texture (formerly AsyncDisplayKit) is a popular open-source UI framework for iOS that keeps even the most complex user interfaces smooth and responsive, primarily through asynchronous UI preloading, layout, and rendering.

I own many parts of the framework including, but not limited to, its FlexBox-based declarative layout system, collection and table views' data pipeline, and asynchronous layout transition. I am also well-versed in the rest of the framework.

Over the years, Texture has powered many highly popular iOS apps such as Pinterest, YouTube, Apollo for Reddit, Google's apps like Photos and Search, The New York Times, Telegram, Reddit (the official app), etc.
